provenance.asset_description: Two Paizo iconic characters overlayed over the blue, pink, and white striped trans flag background. On the left is Mios, the iconic thaumaturge. Dressed is a large jacket covered in charms and talismans, holding a lantern. On the right is Dae, a cat-like Phatra with a cybernetic arm,pointing a smoking finger gun.
